newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rise across the board.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) firmed up across all maturities, with steep rises at the short end of the curve, traders said.
They attributed the firmness to tight domestic liquidity which affected the overnight and termed spot rates.
The rise in long-term PHIBOR was not as pronounced as banks were still waiting for the results of the T-bill auction later in the day, one trader said.
PHIBOR are average foreign exchange forward quotes of 20 banks operating in the market.
